_note: Hand-written paraphrases of historical tickets (relevant = ticket ids an agent would want to see) plus novel issues with no precedent (relevant = []). NT-* mirror starter_kit/data/new_tickets_example.json.

queries.text:
Can't log in, password reset email never arrives
A customer requested a password reset an hour ago and says the email still hasn't shown up, even after checking spam.

Chart shows nothing for the revenue tab
The revenue tab on the main dashboard is completely empty for this customer, no bars, no error message, just white space.

Getting charged twice this month
Customer's card statement shows two charges for what should be a single monthly subscription payment.

Our data warehouse integration with Snowflake is failing
Customer set up a new integration to sync data into their Snowflake warehouse and it's failing with an unclear connection error. This is a newer integration type we haven't seen many tickets about yet.

Okta sign-in sends users to an empty screen
After authenticating through Okta the app just shows a white page.

MFA text message not arriving
User turned on multi-factor auth but the SMS code never comes through.

Locked out after typing wrong password
User tried their password several times and now the account is locked.

Keeps logging us out every few minutes
Team gets kicked out of the app constantly while working in dashboards.

HubSpot connector suddenly failing auth
HubSpot integration worked for a long time and now returns an authentication error.

Same accounts showing up twice after resync
We re-ran the sync manually and now every account appears duplicated.

Salesforce numbers stale on revenue dashboard
Opportunity data from Salesforce stopped updating a few days ago.

Dashboard layout broken on small laptop screen
Widgets are stacked on top of each other on a 13 inch display.

Donut chart percentages total 98
Category breakdown segments do not add up to a hundred percent.

Billed for more seats than active users
Invoice charges for 30 seats but only 22 people use the product.

Can't change the card on file
Updating the payment method in settings throws a generic error.

Still paying the old price after downgrading
We moved to a cheaper plan but the new invoice is at the previous rate.

CSV export is missing the most recent days
Exported transactions stop a week before today.

Monday report email no longer arriving
The scheduled weekly summary email stopped coming a few weeks ago.

Export totals differ from what the dashboard shows
Revenue in the downloaded file doesn't match the live dashboard number.

Invited colleague sees no dashboards
New teammate can log in but their dashboard list is empty.

Terminated employee can still access the app
Admin deactivated the account but the person is still logged in.

Read-only user able to move widgets around
A viewer can drag and rearrange widgets on a shared dashboard.

Dashboard is very slow to load for a big account
Main dashboard takes nearly a minute before it becomes usable.

Getting 429 too many requests from the API
Integration is being rate limited even though traffic is normal.

Webhooks dropped under heavy traffic
Some webhook events never reach our endpoint during busy periods.

Revoked API key is still accepted
We rotated the key but requests with the old key keep succeeding.

Annual billing discount missing
Switched to yearly billing but the 15% discount wasn't applied.

PDF export of a full year fails
Generating a big PDF report errors out after half a minute.

Mobile app crashes on Android when opening notifications
The Android app closes immediately when tapping a push notification.

Request to translate the dashboard UI into German
Our European team would like the interface in German.

BigQuery connector setup fails with a connection error
Trying to connect our Google BigQuery project, the wizard errors out.

Need a copy of your SOC 2 report for procurement
Our security team asked for the latest SOC 2 Type II report.

Custom fonts not applied in white-labeled portal
Brand fonts we uploaded do not appear in the embedded portal.

Can we get a dedicated sandbox environment?
We want a separate staging instance to test configuration changes.
